status: Routing aid for unvalidated drafts; electrical/physical qualification NOT RUN.

rule.reason: IC pin rows carry most of the still-open signal links. Inside these areas Default-class signal tracks may neck down to 0.15 mm width and 0.15 mm signal-to-signal clearance, common practice and within standard 6-layer fabrication capability. Rails and AGND keep their net-class clearance.

basis: Per board, the ICs with a pad on an open Default-class net when `neckdown_areas.py <board> --select` was run.
